source_caption_text:
The confidence was absolutely unmatched 😂

Soulja Boy’s legendary 2019 appearance on The Breakfast Club became one of the most unforgettable moments in hip-hop media. During the interview, he passionately argued that he deserved the title of the biggest comeback of 2018, setting the stage for one of the most chaotic interviews of the era.

Things reached another level when Charlamagne Tha God called Drake the biggest rapper in the world. Soulja Boy immediately jumped up and delivered his iconic “Draaaaaake?!” reaction, before launching into a passionate explanation of why he believed Drake had taken inspiration from his early style.

The interview quickly became a viral moment, spawning countless memes and making Soulja Boy’s reaction part of internet culture. Years later, that “Drake?!” moment is still one of the most recognizable clips from The Breakfast Club.

Via @breakfastclubam 

#souljaboy #drake #hiphop #meme
